scenes.headline: GMod Manager
scenes.sub: Modpacks for Garry's Mod, without the mess
scenes.narration: This is GMod Manager. A small, free app that keeps your Garry's Mod addons nice and tidy.

scenes.headline: Every modpack is a preset
scenes.sub: See every mod, who made it, and how big it is
scenes.narration: Every modpack lives in its own preset. Pick one, and you can see every mod inside it, who made it, and how much space it takes.

scenes.headline: Import any Workshop collection
scenes.narration: Found a Workshop collection you like? Paste the link, and a few seconds later, it's a preset.

scenes.headline: Find mods as you type
scenes.sub: Results update live. One click to add.
scenes.narration: Want more? Just start typing. Results update as you go, and one click adds a mod to your preset.

scenes.headline: A library that remembers
scenes.sub: Mods stay compressed on your drive
scenes.narration: Turn on the library, and every mod is kept compressed on your drive. So switching back to an old preset doesn't mean downloading everything again.

scenes.headline: Hit Play
scenes.sub: GMod starts with exactly your mods
scenes.narration: When you're ready, hit Play. Garry's Mod starts with exactly the mods you picked. Changed your mind? Undo puts everything back.

scenes.headline: GMod Manager
scenes.narration: GMod Manager is free, right now, on GitHub. Have fun out there.
